$comment: check-scripts-index clause 13, the verb census's record. `verbs`: each command-line token a program dispatches on that no step and no ctest entry reaches, with the category that DOES reach it -- driven (a named RUNNING program -- one a step or a ctest entry starts, or a module such a program imports -- that names the program, or imports a module that does, passes it in an argument list), self-driven (the running program passes it to itself), alias (of a spelling reached or recorded, held in one comparison or declaration), test-source (a test source outside the actions names the program and the token) -- and a `why`. A `*` token covers every token of its program, each one still verified; an exact record wins over it. Every record is verified on every run; there is no category for 'run by hand'. `treeWriters`: the steps that write this machine's tree, each reachable through a one-leg runner of this machine's own tree.
